note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official list as PlayStation publishes it, via Exophase and PSNProfiles. Hidden flags follow the PSN split (28 hidden, 27 visible). Every guide is written in our own words for this guide; sources are cited per trophy, never copied.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The Platinum pops by itself the moment the other 54 trophies are earned — there is nothing extra to do. All 55 trophies are offline and single-player, so no online play or DLC is needed for it. Expect roughly 200 hours for the full set at a 4/10 difficulty, according to PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy: it unlocks when you finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1. It cannot be missed — just play the story. PowerPyx lists it as an automatic, unmissable story trophy.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 1. Story chapters unlock in order, so this pops naturally as you play; it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 2. Unmissable story trophy — keep playing the main missions.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 3. Unmissable story trophy.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 4. Unmissable story trophy.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission. This is the last story trophy and it is unmissable — it pops at the end of the campaign, after which the 100% checklist and post-game cleanup open up.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Breakfast Run. A named story mission, so it unlocks automatically while you play the campaign and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission The Cartel Heist. Automatic story trophy, unmissable.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Child's Play. Automatic story trophy, unmissable.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Headliners. Automatic story trophy, unmissable.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission VCIA Takedown. Automatic story trophy, unmissable.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Operation Savage Glory. Automatic story trophy, unmissable.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy in the set, per PowerPyx. After the story, open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion: the checklist appears there, and progress you made before the story ends still counts. The bar is lenient — roughly 60% of true completion — and most of it comes from other trophies: 200 of 277 base-model vehicles scanned and 100 of 255 animals studied through binoculars are the two big counts. Finish the story first, then clear the checklist.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts — jumps, air time and other stunt moves all count toward the same total. It builds up naturally while you drive around Leonida; use this guide's counter to track it, and grind long jumps off ramps if you want to finish it early.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all nine activity types once: Fishing, Hunting, Golf, Shooting Ranges, Pool, Basketball, playing a video game, winning a car race / race challenge / Top Fun drone race, and performing a stunt. Check Touchpad > Progress > Activities — it shows how many of the nine you have done. One try each is enough; you do not need to win or finish them all.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: There are 12 shooting ranges across Leonida with 42 challenges between them, and every one needs a gold medal. Work range by range — the counter here tracks your golds out of 42. Use a steady weapon, take your time on the timed lanes, and repeat a challenge until the gold time or score lands.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of its locations. The exact number of locations is not pinned down in the published guides yet, so treat every location you find as one to win at — the trophy pops when the last location is won. Drone handling is the skill to practise, not speed alone.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — each distinct race counts once, so vary the events instead of repeating one. Car races, race challenges and Top Fun drone races all count as race wins for the activity list, and your wins across all of them build toward this total.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Challenge Cal to a fishing contest and beat him. Fishing is one of the nine activity types, so practise the fishing minigame first — landing the bigger catch wins the challenge. The exact spot where Cal appears is not pinned down in the published guides yet.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Play any arcade game to completion — find an arcade cabinet, start a game and finish it. Any title counts; pick the one you find easiest and play it through to the end.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's stranger mission strand — the final mission in his chain pops this trophy. Stranger strands unlock as you explore Leonida and meet their characters; complete each mission Andy offers until his strand ends.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's stranger mission strand, up to and including his final mission. Follow his missions as they appear on the map until the strand closes.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's stranger mission strand, up to and including his final mission. Keep taking his missions as they appear until the strand closes.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete eight full stranger mission strands across Leonida — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone each have one, plus three more strangers to find. Each strand ends with its own trophy, so finishing all five named strands gets you most of the way there. Explore the map and take every stranger mission you meet.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's stranger mission strand, up to and including his final mission. Take his missions as they appear until the strand closes.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's stranger mission strand, up to and including his final mission. Take his missions as they appear until the strand closes.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: THE missable trophy — the only one PowerPyx flags. There are 18 meditation spots in 10 locations, to visit as Jason and Lucia. The first spot is offered at Jason's house in Chapter 1 and becomes permanently unavailable once Chapter 1 ends, so meditate there before you finish the chapter. After that, work through the remaining spots whenever you pass one; the counter here tracks 18.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret Vogel's questline opens after the Chapter 2 story mission Coffee Break. On his first quest he hands you the unique hunting rifle 'Killtelligence SM-69'. Follow his hunts until he asks you to take down a unique animal — that hunt pops the trophy.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Finish three full collectible card sets. Cards are hidden across Leonida — pick them up as you explore and check your collection to see which sets are close to complete. The counter here tracks sets finished, out of 3.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK It feature at 100 different locations. Each new location counts once, so use it everywhere you go instead of saving it for one area — the counter here tracks your 100. It pairs naturally with exploring all of Leonida.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Finish 50 in-game challenges — the challenge list covers driving, combat, exploration and more. Most complete passively while you chase other trophies; check the challenges menu to see which ones are close, then mop up the remainder deliberately.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then break line of sight and escape. Use alleys, tunnels and off-road routes to shake the search, and stay out of sight until the stars clear — the trophy pops once you are clean.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob three shops in a row without ever losing your wanted level between them — keep the heat alive from the first robbery to the third. Plan a route with three close shops, hit them fast, and do not let the stars clear until the third is done.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles — drive or scan new models and each new one counts. It feeds the 100% checklist too, which needs 200 of 277 base models scanned, so keep discovering past 100. The counter here tracks your 100.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: In one Combat Focus (slow-motion aim) activation, take down five enemies. Set it up where enemies group together — a gang hideout or a shootout with cover — then trigger Focus and drop five before it ends. Ammo and a fast weapon help.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Leave Vice City International Airport in an unscheduled way — the natural read is stealing a plane and taking off without a booked flight. The exact trigger is not pinned down in the published guides yet, so try a runway departure in a stolen aircraft. The airport stays open, so nothing here can be missed.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a Rhino tank. Tanks sit at the Mile Zero Air Station in the south of the map — walk in, take one and drive off, which draws a 3-star wanted level. Just getting in and driving away pops the trophy.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without anyone spotting you — no alerts, no cameras catching you, no guard raising the alarm. Go quiet: watch patrols, move between cover, and get in and out before anyone notices. If you are spotted, leave and try again.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob five bank vaults and escape after each one. Each vault is its own job — plan the getaway before you go in, and count them with the counter here. Five successful escapes pops the trophy.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Ambush an armored truck, crack it open, take the cash and escape. Trucks run set routes around Leonida — stop one, deal with its guards, break in, then lose any wanted level that follows.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Visit every region of Leonida — the whole map, from Vice City to the swamps and the Keys. The trophy pops when the last unexplored region is covered. Pair it with WAiNK It at 100 locations and vehicle discovery, which reward the same exploring.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation for every gang in Leonida. Each gang runs its own operations — find them, hit one per gang, and the trophy pops when every gang has been hit once.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Order a cocktail somewhere with a view on Ocean Beach and enjoy it. The exact bar or spot is not pinned down in the published guides yet — PowerPyx lists this one as not yet known — so try the beachfront bars along Ocean Drive until it pops.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Drive a car straight through a vehicle showroom's window and out the other side. The exact showroom is not pinned down in the published guides yet — PowerPyx lists this one as not yet known — so try the big dealership showrooms in Vice City.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play a full game at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and follow through to the end — the trophy is about completing the game there, not a high score. Find the alley, bowl the frames, and finish the game.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: The description points at a partnership milestone — most likely something you do with your partner that draws a crowd. The exact trigger is not pinned down in the published guides yet, so keep playing partner activities and check back as guides fill in the details.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: This one is about a story choice — the description reads like a decision with consequences. Play the story and make the choice when it comes; it is most likely unmissable through normal story play, but the exact moment is not pinned down in the published guides yet.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: 'Second time's the charm' reads like a retry: fail at something once, then succeed on the second attempt. The exact event is not pinned down in the published guides yet — PowerPyx lists this one as not yet known — so it will likely pop on its own during normal play.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Something strange has to happen — the description reads like a UFO or paranormal encounter. The exact event is not pinned down in the published guides yet — PowerPyx lists this one as not yet known — so treat it as one to watch for while exploring odd corners of Leonida.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Score a melee drive-by that bowls people over — attack from a moving vehicle with a melee weapon. The exact count is not pinned down in the published guides yet — PowerPyx lists this one as not yet known — so try a drive-by melee swing through a group and see if it pops.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and illegal work; pass them to your contacts to clean them, and the total adds up across the whole game. Track the running total with the counter here.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across all shops — weapons, clothes, cars, anything. Spending counts cumulatively, so it builds on its own as you gear up; if you are close, buy a big-ticket item to finish it off.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy every garage property in Leonida. Garages are bought through the property market — save up, then buy each one as it becomes available. The exact number of garages is not pinned down in the published guides yet.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register ten vehicles you own in the Scooter Bros app. Own the vehicle, open the app, register it — repeat ten times. Any ten vehicles count, so use the ones you already own first.
